name: Dynamic Loading and Progressive Update
aliases: Chargement dynamique et mise à jour progressive
definition: Strategy for visualizing massive scenes by dynamically and adaptively loading data based on viewpoint position, bounding memory usage to visible data and required resolution.
summary: Dynamic Loading and Progressive Update adaptively loads data based on viewpoint and resolution, distinguishing itself by incrementally updating the data structure and spreading heavy loads across frames to maintain real-time fluidity.
